text:
Anya: Quick sync — now that launch is stable, we need a concise post-launch playbook for the next 2 weeks. We have: customer A reporting a high-frequency fail (repro steps attached), + design asks to ship feature-grid improvements. How do you want to split scope? prioritize bugs first or balance by user impact? :thinking:
Sam: +1 need a rubric. My proposal: P0 regressions or anything causing data loss => immediate hotfix. P1 high-usage flows that drop conversion => fast follow. Everything else gets scoring by impact x effort. 
Morgan: Agreed. Can we add signal from telemetry? If a bug impacts >1% DAU or causes p99 spike -> escalate. Also record customer SLA weight (customer A is enterprise).
Liam: Practical playbook suggestion: 
- Day 0: Triage window (2h) to tag P0/P1 and owners
- Days 1-3: Hotfix window for P0s (canary + emergency deploy) 
- Day 4-10: Parallel grooming: pull top 3 P1 bugs + 1 enhancement per squad
- End of week 2: Release mini-iteration + monitoring window
We should reserve one engineer/day for on-callable hotfixes.
Anya: Love the cadence. For prioritization scoring, can we use a 0-5 scale for Impact and 0-5 for Effort and compute Impact/Effort? Also flag enterprise customers to multiply impact by 2.
Sam: Yep. Draft rubric: Impact (DAU%, business friction, SLA breach) Effort (dev + infra + QA). We should bake into the grooming template.
Morgan: I'll pull telemetry slices for the last 7 days and tag candidates. Can we add a 'risk to rollout' column for enhancements? Some design changes have higher rollback cost.
Liam: infra-bot: scheduled canary pipeline is set for Friday 09:30 UTC if we need it. Use tag #canary-1. infra-bot: deploy window reserved.
Anya: Next steps: Morgan to post telemetry slices by EOD Thursday; Sam to write the rubric + grooming template; Liam to allocate an engineer per day to the hotfix rota. We'll run the first triage on Friday 10:00 in #product. If no objections, I'll create the grooming board and invite PMs/ENGs. :thumbsup:
Sam: Sounds good. I'll start the rubric draft now.
Morgan: On it, will post links.
Liam: I'll assign rota after sync.
Anya: Thanks all — landing this playbook should let us balance critical fixes while keeping follow-on momentum for enhancements. :rocket:
